authority: 2026-09-18 owner requested preparation first, then a concrete plan for the next work. The 2026-09-10 assume-and-continue decision remains the product authority.
objective: Prepare an isolated current workspace and define a source-backed, bounded implementation sequence for persistent assumptions and uninterrupted provisional review.
bounded_units: Verify workspace, dependencies, predecessor state and existing source/test owners
Extend the maintained workflow with contracts, sequential implementation units, acceptance evidence and later gates
Reconcile current entry points and deliver one documentation-only candidate

acceptance_rows.outcome: The task starts on fetched main in an isolated branch; the original edit and retained worktrees are preserved, and dependency readiness is recorded truthfully.
Current input, mapping, dispatch, persistence and verification owners are traced and bound to source hashes; proposed behavior is distinguished from working behavior.
One planned effective-input contract covers precedence, all sixteen data groups, provisional/source identities, persistence, invalid edits, required-check truth and dependency updates.
Each next milestone has bounded units, measurable acceptance, exact maintained test/harness owners, a candidate ceiling and no premature claim of broader model qualification.
Maintained entry points agree, documentation and lifecycle checks pass, and no runtime, preset, user model, workbook or installed artifact is changed.

non_goals: Implement the resolver, new engineering methods or automatic dispatch in this planning task
Launch or modify Excel/ETABS, install a package, issue engineering results or publish a release
Resume final performance certification, optimization or copied-model reanalysis
Clean, reset or delete retained branches, worktrees or the original user edit
likely_pitfalls: Planning only sheet defaults while leaving actual typed requests unchanged
Treating review completion as full engineering qualification
Carrying source-specific assumptions between different models
Inventing a service load, source fact or passing fire check
Repeating broad gates or publishing one PR per internal implementation unit
